note: The ribbon while it is collapsed, and the whole lists of its transitions' and builds' galleries. While it is collapsed, a tab shows it over the slide, a click elsewhere or Escape hides it again, and its pin keeps it open in its place. Its tabs are the same component as the pinned ribbon's; only one of the two is ever built.
